selection_on_w00big_only.labels: HF inklabels_v2 + supervision_mask_v2 on the w00 grid (labels-on-grid.py convention)

selection_on_w00big_only.tie_break: within 0.01 AUCsup of the best: highest hp r at sigma 192 um, output blur 2 px, against ScrollPrize's 2.4 um map
frozen_arms: the best single member by the same rule (guards ensemble letter-softening, edges -19 to -25% in ckpt-ens)

decisive_on_252405.labels: HF inklabels_v2 + supervision_mask_v2 + validation_mask_v2 carried onto the 252405 render grid by the same convention as w00 (rebuild; the existing grids are S3 20260918, reported beside, never decisive)
decisive_on_252405.ceiling: C = AUCsup of ScrollPrize's 2.4 um map on the same labels and pixels (0.8609 HF v2)
decisive_on_252405.why_normalised: the plan's 0.85 / 0.80 bars were set against w00, where C = 0.954 (HF v2); on 252405 C = 0.861, so raw 0.85 would demand 97% of the 2.4 um map. The bars carry over as nAUC: 0.85 on w00 = 0.771, 0.80 = 0.661. Fixed now, before any 9 um map of 252405 exists.
decisive_on_252405.go_to_letter_read: nAUC >= 0.771 (raw about 0.778) AND hp r at 192 um, blur 2, above the 48-shift rolled-key null max AND forward order and a depth-shuffled stack inside their nulls
decisive_on_252405.ambiguous: 0.661 <= nAUC < 0.771: read anyway, result marked ambiguous
decisive_on_252405.exhausted: nAUC < 0.661: the existing readers have run out; go to the student branch
decisive_on_252405.report_also: raw AUCsup (HF v2 and S3), hp r at 48 and 192 um, the released s43-75k baseline on the same pixels

sanity_gates_before_scoring: gate 1: the model-free direct render (layers 18-22) inside its rolled null by raw r AND by hp r at blur 0 (the hp half was not run in day 1)
gate 2: released s43-75k local shift scan against the 2.4 um map peaks within 1 px of (0,0)

letter_read.scorable: only reference letters whose box centre lies inside the 252405 render crop: 8 of the 10
letter_read.match: same identity (Reader A's listed alternatives accepted), reader's box centre within 0.5 mm (52 render px at 9.612 um) of Reader A's BOX centre
